item.title: Houthis take control of Yemen’s entire Red Sea coast, reports say
item.description: The Iran-backed Houthi forces have taken control over most of the western Red Sea coastal line

item.title: Can the Houthis close the Red Sea after seizing the Yemen coast?
item.description: Some observers see a force that has improved impressively in the past years, but others doubt the Houthis can sustain wins.

item.title: Why Pakistan is talking to Iran as the Houthi-Saudi fight escalates
item.description: Pakistan faces growing pressure to honour its Saudi defence commitments while keeping diplomatic channels to Iran open.

item.title: Russian strikes kill two in Kyiv as Moscow targets capital’s fuel stations
item.description: Second day of strikes on fuel stations suggest a new campaign focused on civilian areas in the Ukrainian capital.

item.title: Swiss police report five killed in Dutch tour bus crash
item.description: Bus carrying 45 Dutch tourists overturned and landed in a construction zone near an Alpine village.

item.title: Al Jazeera explains massive Israeli blasts on south Lebanon hill
item.description: Israeli forces say they used more than 1,100 tonnes of explosives to demolish alleged Hezbollah tunnels in south Lebanon

item.title: ‘Blew the hell out of it’: How Iran damaged US bases in Bahrain, Jordan
item.description: US official admits the naval base near Manama sustained heavy damage in the war with Iran.

item.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
item.description: The powerful blast registered as the equivalent of a magnitude 4.1 earthquake, according to the US Geological Survey.

item.title: How global trade and oil prices could be hit by Houthi advance
item.description: Yemen's Houthis have seized territory near the Bab al-Mandab Strait - a key trade gateway for oil and global shipping.

item.title: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
item.description: Officials say there was a stampede as they fled a fire that engulfed two schools in the eastern rebel-held city of Bukavu.
